description: Serum creatinine concentration documented in an eligible record.
measurement_definition: Extract the numeric serum creatinine result reported in mg/dL from the supplied eligible records. Ignore unrelated findings. When more than one eligible serum creatinine result is present, use the latest result by explicit observation date; if dates tie, use the result appearing later in source order.
missing_value_rule: Return null when no eligible serum creatinine result is documented, when the result is nonnumeric without a supported exact value, or when its unit cannot be resolved to mg/dL without an unambiguous stated conversion.
caveats: Do not treat ordinary results from different dates as contradictions. Do not use unrelated clinical findings to infer a value.
